title: Asynchrony and cancellation
goal: Accept current intent, cancel No and reject stale answers without persisting a document.
prerequisites: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Stale answer rejected without claiming remote cancellation.
sections: An asynchronous dialog returns control before the user answers. Decision-dependent logic belongs in its continuation rather than the next line as if synchronous. Meanwhile, the form may close, data may change or another request may start. Include those states in the operation contract.

УчебноеПодтверждение increments ВерсияЗапроса and captures minutes. ПоказатьВопрос yields to the UI; ОписаниеОповещения calls ПослеПодтверждения later. Reaching the line after opening a dialog does not mean an answer exists.

Preserve request identity and the confirmed snapshot. Before acting, check form and intent validity. An oldYesmust not authorize a new request; double-clicking must not create a duplicate. Use explicitpending/accepted/cancelledstate instead of one flag that conflates attempts.

No sets Cancelled immediately. Yes permits calculation only when request generation and current minutes match the snapshot. An old confirmation for77 must not act after editing90 or starting another request. The snapshot contains intent data, never credentials.

No, dialog close and form cancellation must not initiate a write. Once a server operation has committed, localUIcancel need not reverse it: show actual state and a verification route. A closed window does not prove server-effect cancellation. Distinguish timeout and environment unavailability.

Even acceptance only computes hours; no document write occurs. Check cancellation using the result and persisted30. In a real remote operation closing a dialog does not revoke an already accepted server effect: use an operation ID and reconcile outcome.

TestYes, No, double-click, response after close and two replies arriving in reverse order. Tie each to its ownIDand state. One fast success does not test asynchrony: use a controlled delay in a safe stand and verify no late write. An explanatory event diagram is notBSLexecution.

Manually test Yes/No through the actual dialog. Separately invoke the exported continuation with current/stale versions and changed minutes to reproduce event ordering. That executes real BSL branches but does not prove a physical dialog click. Report these evidence types separately.
